source_reference.title: Critical temperature and duration for high temperature-induced sterility in indica rice (TARC Notes, JARQ 11(3))

rules.source_excerpt: Heat-induced spikelet sterility in indica rice at flowering; 35 C used as the screening threshold. Other literature cites 33 C.
rules.notes: DISABLED. Source is a phytotron (controlled-environment) study, not ICAR/ANGRAU field guidance; 33 vs 35 C disagreement; duration of exposure matters and is not represented by a daily maximum; severity is unassigned by the source. Needs agronomist sign-off and a matching temporal measurement before enabling.
